Company Overview

A Trusted Crewing & Agency Partner

Sea & Seas Shipping Private Limited was established in 2008 in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Holding ISO 9001:2015 accreditation, we provide complete ship management, crew recruitment, technical superintendence, and comprehensive port agency services across India and the United Arab Emirates.

We pride ourselves on supplying thoroughly vetted, medically certified, and English-speaking deck/engine officers and crew. Our web-based crew administration software gives shipowners 24/7 real-time visibility into their fleet's personnel, certifications, performance, and rotation schedules.

What We Do

Manifest Of Services

SVC—01
Crew Management (Full Manning)
Rigorous recruitment of STCW-certified officers and ratings for Dry Cargo, Bulk Carriers, Tankers, Containers, and Offshore DP vessels. Includes pre-joining medicals, visa processing, flag documentation, payroll, and 24/7 web-based owner portal access.
+
SVC—02
Ship Management & Operations
Daily vessel operations, planned maintenance systems (PMS), drydock supervision, expenditure control, marine insurance/claims handling, and technical support ensuring zero downtime.
+
SVC—03
Ship Agency & Husbandry (India & U.A.E)
Full port agency at Mumbai, JNPT, Kandla, Mundra, Cochin, Chennai, as well as Ajman, Sharjah Khalid, and Hamriyah ports in the UAE. Services include berth planning, customs/coastguard clearance, crew sign-on/sign-off, hotel/flight logistics, and bunker/freshwater supplies.
+
SVC—04
Offshore DP Fleet Manning
Specialized crew management for DP-1/DP-2 AHTS, Platform Supply Vessels (PSV), Diving Support Vessels (DSV), Crew Boats, and Accommodation Work Barges for oil majors and national oil companies.
+
SVC—05
Technical Support, ISM/ISPS & Quality Assurance
Superintendence, pre-purchase surveys, vetting inspection preparations (SIRE/CDI), ISM/ISPS code internal audits, and class certification coordination.
+
SVC—06
Flag State Documentation & STCW Training
Endorsements and license processing for major flag administrations (Panama, Liberia, Marshall Islands, Belize, Honduras, Singapore, India). Facilitation of simulator-based value-added training.
+
SVC—07
Ship Chartering & Commercial Brokering
Commercial freight administration, voyage calculations, laytime/demurrage settlement, and post-fixture operations for shipowners and charterers.
+

Dispatch — Bilateral Dialogue

Raising Seafarer Welfare With Iran's Port & Maritime Organisation

Tehran, Iran 10 July 2019
PMO Conference Hall
  • 01Directors Capt. Ujjawal B. Choudhary and management representatives met Iranian owners and PMO officials to discuss seafarer rights, safety, and welfare.
  • 02Discussions focused on the Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA), maritime safety protocols, and recruitment exclusively through accredited agencies.
  • 03PMO agreed to an online grievance portal and strict enforcement of MLC 2006 on salary disbursement, sign-off schedules, and repatriation guarantees.
  • 04An initiative for comprehensive seafarer insurance and port-state welfare was accepted by Iranian shipowners.
PMO CONFERENCE HALL · TEHRAN

Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

What nationalities and vessel types do you recruit for? +
We recruit complete crews across all ranks: Master, Chief Officer, 2nd/3rd Officers, Chief Engineer, 2nd/3rd/4th Engineers, Electro-Technical Officers (ETO), Bosun, AB, OS, Fitter, Pumpman, and Chief Cook. Our experience spans Bulk Carriers, Product/Chemical Tankers, Offshore DP Vessels (AHTS/PSV), Container Ships, and Tugs.
How does Sea & Seas verify sea-time and certificate authenticity? +
Every candidate undergoes a multi-tier verification process: biometric INDOS & CDC cross-verification via government databases, direct sea-service confirmation with previous vessel managers, and technical competency interviews conducted by our in-house Master Mariners and Chief Engineers.
What is the typical crew mobilization turnaround time? +
With our pre-vetted roster of officers and ratings, emergency crew mobilization can take place within 48 to 72 hours for Indian, Gulf, and Singapore ports. For planned rotations and full crew complements, standard turnaround is 7 to 14 working days including Flag State endorsements, visa processing, and medicals.
What port agency services do you provide in India and the UAE? +
We provide 24/7 port representation in Mumbai, JNPT, Kandla, Mundra, Pipavav, Cochin, Chennai, and Vizag (India), as well as Ajman, Sharjah Khalid, and Hamriyah (UAE). Services include customs clearance, berthing assistance, crew sign-on/sign-off repatriation, bunker supply, freshwater, marine spares clearance, and ship husbandry.
Do you provide real-time software access for shipowners? +
Yes. Sea & Seas operates a proprietary web-based crew administration system that allows shipowners and technical managers 24/7 online access to crew profiles, matrix compliance, appraisal reports, travel details, and contract timelines.
